## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about privacy, hotkeys, and platform support.

### How does the desktop overlay interact with my open windows?

Lumen uses lightweight native OS APIs to capture the exact pixels only when you invoke Ctrl+Space (or Cmd+Space on macOS) and make an explicit selection. It never records your screen continuously in the background or monitors keystrokes.

### How does Stealth Mode stay invisible on screen shares and recordings?

On Windows, Lumen applies the native WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE window display affinity flag. This tells the Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) compositor to omit the overlay window from any GPU capture stream used by Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, OBS Studio, and Discord.

### Where is my session history stored?

Your desktop conversations and prompt history are stored locally on your device in your user directory. They are never synchronized to public databases or shared between users.

### Is my screen context stored on remote servers?

Screenshots are only processed ephemerally for the immediate request you submit. They are discarded immediately after generating the response and are never used to train frontier foundation models.

### How does Pro billing work?

Pro is $20 per month on a monthly plan, or $15 per month when billed annually as $180 per year. Checkout runs directly through Stripe. You can upgrade, manage invoices, or cancel anytime from the Billing dashboard.
